title: thelypteris standleyi
intro: Thelypteris standleyi, commonly known as the Standing Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a non-vascular plant that belongs to the group of vascular cryptogams, characterized by its unique leaf structure and ability to reproduce via spores. The Standing Fern has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris standleyi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
